subject: social_studies
concept: Understanding stereotypes: assuming something about a whole group of people based on limited or unfair information
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Wisdom and Compassion Pillars — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student compares a stereotype to a real, more accurate description of the same group

misconception_flags: accepts a stated stereotype as generally true rather than recognizing it as an unfair generalization
